q: Which content is usually the bulkiest and least useful part of a long agent context?
explain: Tool outputs dominate token counts and go stale quickly; clear or summarize them after use.

q: Why should you avoid editing earlier messages in an agent’s history?
options: It is not allowed by APIs
It invalidates the prompt cache and can confuse the model about what happened
explain: Append-only context keeps cache hits high and the history coherent.

q: What is the main purpose of compaction?
options: To keep a long-running task going by summarizing history into decisions and next steps
explain: Compaction resets the context to a summary so work can continue past the window.
